Change complete and verified.

**Changes in `app/page.tsx`:**
- Removed the full-name input; added controlled first-name and last-name inputs side by side in a single flex row (`flex gap-2`, each `flex-1`).

- The combined first + last name now renders as an `<h1>` title directly under the Upload Photo button (only when non-empty), centered with `text-xl font-semibold`.
- Preserved the title input, photo/upload button, specialization select, and language chips; each new input keeps an `aria-label` (`Doctor's first name` / `Doctor's last name`).

**Commands run:**
- `npm run verify:agent` → exit 0, "render smoke passed: HTTP 200"

**Remaining risks:** Minor — the upload photo button and title are both inside the centered column, so with long names the title wraps within the centered container; no interaction (click/state transition) test exists beyond the render smoke check.
